digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter — user identity model
propositions: Jira Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId while Data Center identifies them by name, leaking into assignee resolution and payload shape.
PR #120's implementation returns authoritative=False for all DC assignees because _assignee_resolver is never set, causing diff churn on every pass.
A UserIdentityModel Protocol must abstract resolve(local_value, remote_identity) returning (value, authoritative, is_account_id) and to_payload(value) for deployment-specific assignee field shape.
NameIdentity must perform real lookup against DC user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and converge diff, not echo local value with authoritative=False.
Unresolvable assignees must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently return non-authoritative values.
DC identity model must return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees to prevent assignee-diff churn.
